newFindings.finding: Acción requerida #N uses historical comment sequence rather than current actionable queue rank.
Action-required and completed/returned states do not have sufficiently strong, distinct visual priority.
Opening a card waits on Orbit.cat.ensure() before first paint and takes ~4s in human use.
Comments/requests area is visually flat and does not clearly state that Registrar commits immediately while Guardar cambios belongs to business fields.
Marcar atendida/Archivar waits for server+refresh without visible pending/success state, encouraging repeated clicks.
Active-count placement/hierarchy is visually weak and detached from header.
Header/stepper/comments spacing, yellow band, internal scrolling and menu density are not acceptable for a high-frequency daily surface.
Existing insurer Drive folder is not embedded/browsable in the ficha with role-aware access; current drive field is only a reference string.
Flow is titled Importación inteligente but docs-aseguradora is forced to documentary mode and performs no content extraction/mapping.
Activity/source details expose Registry, KNOWLEDGE_REFERENCE, hashes and structural labels rather than user/action/result language.
Changing only logo can report many unrelated changed fields because draft normalization changes undefined/empty structures and diff uses raw top-level JSON.stringify.
Logo/upload/save can take seconds before the visible Guardando state begins.
Phone entry does not enforce/select international country code and can persist ambiguous numbers.
Large unresolved country population requires deterministic source-backed backfill/readback, not only per-row UI suggestions.
Historical expired policies are not dispositioned by the approved business cutoff; old expireds pollute historical state while recent expireds need actionable pipeline treatment.

scheduleFinding.evidence: Cadence scheduler runs every 60 minutes with timeZone America/Guatemala; localDate also uses America/Guatemala.
